## MC Hoster 3.6.0

- **Backups.** Your world is backed up once a day while the server runs, and the newest 5 are kept. The new **Backups…** button on the Play tab has **Back up now**, **Restore** and **Open folder**. Restoring keeps the world as it was, just in case.
- **Who's online.** The Play tab shows who is on the server and how long it has been up.
- The terms now link to the full **Terms of Use** and **Privacy** pages on the website.
- **New website:** a clickable tour of the app, a memory calculator, a "which server type?" helper, live update logs, and Terms and Privacy pages.
